title: One Way Invisible Block
description: A fully invisible block that can be walked through from one side, but not the other.
body: One-Way Invisible Block adds a fully invisible block that can be passed through from one side while remaining solid from the other. Perfect for secret entrances, hidden passages, security systems, adventure maps, minigames, and technical builds. The block does not interfere with lighting and blends seamlessly into any environment, allowing you to create smart barriers without affecting the look of your world.
